extracted.name: Mississippi Mud Cookies
extracted.description: Use this recipe for terrific no-bake Mississippi mud cookies with coconut, oats, and nuts that will remind you of Mississippi mud ice cream.
instruction_lines: Bring sugar, butter, and milk to a boil in a large saucepan. Boil for 2 minutes and remove from heat.
Stir in cocoa and vanilla. Stir in oats, walnuts, and coconut until well combined.
Drop tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper. Cool for 30 minutes before serving.
